name: Perindopril
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.action: Contraindicated. Do not give within 36 hours of switching to or from sacubitril/valsartan.

key_interactions.effect: Dual RAS blockade: hypotension, hyperkalemia, kidney function changes (label).
key_interactions.action: Do not combine in diabetes; avoid if GFR below 60 mL/min.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: ARBs or other ACE inhibitors (dual RAS blockade)
key_interactions.effect: More hypotension, hyperkalemia and acute kidney failure, usually without added benefit (label).
key_interactions.action: In general avoid; if used, closely monitor blood pressure, kidney function and electrolytes.

key_interactions.effect: Excessive blood-pressure drop when the ACE inhibitor is started, especially after recent diuretic start (label).
key_interactions.action: Reduce or pause the diuretic or start a lower ACE inhibitor dose; supervise after the first dose.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Potassium-sparing diuretics, potassium supplements, salt substitutes and other potassium-raising drugs (heparin, cyclosporine)

key_interactions.effect: Worse kidney function, possible acute kidney failure in older, volume-depleted or CKD patients; weaker antihypertensive effect (label).
Higher lithium levels and toxicity, more so with a diuretic (label).
Nitritoid reactions: flushing, nausea, vomiting, hypotension (label).
